units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 2:1">Yoma II, 1</cite> <he>בראשונה כל מי שרוצה לִתְרוֹם … תּוֹרֵם</he> formerly whosoever wanted to remove the ashes from the altar, could do it.

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 2:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>התקינו שלא יהו תוֹרְמִין וכ׳</he> it was arranged that they should clean the altar only by lot. Y. ib. 39ᵇ bot. <he>זר שת׳</he> if an outsider removed the ashes.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:2">Tam. I, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:4">4</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to separate the priestly gift, to make T’rumah.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 1:1">Ter. I, 1</cite> <he>חמשה לא יִתְרוֹמוּ ואם תָּרְמוּ וכ׳</he> five persons should not make T’rumah, and if they did &c., v. <cite ref="V00962"><he>תְּרוּמָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>התּוֹרֵם את שאינו שלו</he> he that separates T’rumah from what does not belong to him.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 1:1">Ib.</cite> <he>נכרי שת׳ את של ישראל</he> if a gentile makes T’rumah of what belongs to an Israelite. Ib. 4 <he>אין תורמין זיתים על השמן וכ׳</he> you cannot consecrate olives as T’rumah for oil, or grapes for wine. Ib. 5 <he>אין תורמין מן הלקט וכ׳</he> you are not bound to give the priestly share out of the gleanings &c.; a. fr.
